content.title: Michigan vs UConn NCAA championship recap tonight: Wolverines beat Huskies for title
content.text: Updated April 6, 2026, 11:54 p.m. ETThe Michigan Wolverines defeat the Connecticut Huskies 69-63 for the national championship at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis.Michigan last won it all in 1989, and it's the Big Ten's first championship since 2000.Elliot Cadeau leads the Wolverines with 19 points. Michigan perseveres despite poor 3-point shooting.Connecticut couldn't earn its third national championship in four seasons.The Michigan Wolverines defeat the UConn Huskies 69-63 in the March Madness national championship game at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. The Wolverines win their second championship and first since 1989. It's the Big Ten's first title since Michigan State in 2000.Elliot Cadeau scores 19 points to lead Michigan, while Yaxel Lendeborg, slowed by leg injuries, has 13 points. Morez Johnson Jr. adds 12 points and 10 rebounds; Trey McKenney has 9 points and 8 rebounds, and Aday Mara scores 8.Michigan struggles mightily from long range (2-of-15) but makes 25-of-28 free throws.Alex Karaban has 17 points and 11 rebounds to lead UConn, which was seeking its third championship in four seasons. Tarris Reed Jr. has 13 points and 14 rebounds.Braylon Mullins, last year's Indiana Mr. Basketball who sent UConn to the Final Four with his last-second 3-pointer vs. Duke, has 11 points and 7 rebounds. Solo Ball, hindered by foul trouble, scores 11.The Huskies also have 3-point issues (9-of-33) and hit just 31% from the field. No one has had a fast break, a pace that favors Connecticut. However, the Wolverines have a 6-2 rebounding edge. UConn injury report vs Michigan: Will Solo Ball play tonight in the NCAA championship game March Madness final?Solo Ball, UConn's third-leading scorer, suffered a foot sprain in the Huskies' win over Illinois in the national semifinals and was in a walking boot Sunday. He said he plans on playing. Michigan injury report vs UConn: Will Yaxel Lendeborg play tonight in the NCAA championship game March Madness final?Michigan leading scorer Yaxel Lendeborg suffered injuries to his left knee and ankle in the first half of its win over Arizona in the national semifinals, though he returned to the game in the second half, scoring 11 points. May grew up in Greene County, Indiana, and was a student manager for Bob Knight's Indiana teams from 1996-2000.UConn coach Dan Hurley is looking for his third NCAA basketball championship in four yearsDan Hurley is the always-animated eighth-year coach who guided the Huskies to national championships in 2023 and '24. He previously coached two years at Wagner and six at Rhode Island. His brother, Bobby Hurley, was the previous NCAA career assists record-holder before Purdue's Braden Smith surpassed him this year.
